description: R0-35-EXIT-PROOF review repair (SEC-R035-2): a todo a Release 0 suite keeps because its fix landed elsewhere is CLOSED in release0-index.json only when the closing proof is a case a manifest proof:release0 runs requires. This manifest binds the two closing proofs no manifest bound. R0-27 review ST-27-1 (commerce-invoice-errors.integration.test.ts: POST recurring-invoices bound a foreign contactId, cross-tenant) is closed by V1-12 review ST-12-3, proven by the 'TENANT: a schedule never binds or bills another business's contact' block of test/recurring-invoice-run.integration.test.ts (its 3 cases are required; the suite's other cases are V1-12's). R0-27 review ST-27-5 (owner ruling D-64) is closed by FOLLOW3-D6 / W3-D64-COMMERCE-CREATE, proven by test/commerce-contact-bind-visibility.integration.test.ts (every case that passed at the repair head, 26, is required: the suite is the D-64 proof). allowAdditionalCases is true. Run from the repo root: node scripts/proof-admission/run-manifests.mjs --only release0-closing-proofs.json (or pnpm --filter server proof:release0), against a migrated isolated database and REDIS_URL.
